title: Route every supported reasoning workflow through Susi's cloud brain policy
goal: Audit and wire user-intent interpretation, planning, task decomposition, tool selection, execution reasoning, error diagnosis, swarm coordination, memory synthesis, independent verification and self-improvement through the shared strongest-working-cloud brain selector. Produce a testable inventory of production entry points and remove silent local/weaker-model defaults that bypass policy. Deterministic control-plane commands and native tool execution remain deterministic; the brain reasons and delegates through existing grants. Cloud input uses only policy-eligible redacted context. Hermetic integration tests exercise each supported reasoning entry point and prove the selected brain actually receives inference requests, not just a reported preference. Implement nonzero tests named powerful_cloud_brain_wiring_* exercising production behavior.
